answer: New identities must win 5 of 9 votes from a jury chosen by a zephyr draw of the harbor pool, each juror staking 10 POA, slashed if it proves fake within 60 days; the applicant pays 15 POA. Bribing 5 jurors per fake grows costlier as slashed jurors leave: 100 fakes need 500 corrupt votes plus 1,500 POA in fees, each juror serves at most 3 juries per epoch, so the attacker must corrupt ever more members. Draws, votes and slashes sit on-chain for any verifier; a juror who backs 2 fakes is banned from the trellis for 12 epochs. A thin-history applicant may fail once and reapply after 7 days.
